title: Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachum
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 55a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.55a.1-2): Rabbi Chanina bar Agil asked Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanilai, "Why is it that in the first Commandments 'good' is not stated, while in the latter Commandments 'good' is stated?" He said to him: "Thus Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachum told me—he was the brother of the mother of Rav Acha bar Rabbi Chanina, and some say the father of the mother of Rav Achi bar Rabbi Chanina: Since they were destined to be broken."[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman gives two relations—maternal uncle or maternal grandfather—and two forms, Acha and Achai. They are preserved separately.

The [preceding passage at 54b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.54b.29) has Rabbi Chanina ben Agil ask Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba before approaching Rabbi Tanchum. Hyman abbreviates the exchange. The linked 55a has Tanchum quote Shmuel bar Nachum. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3356&lang=en) also records the two alternative family relationships.
